newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures dive on Thai baht float.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures dive on Thai baht float.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures dived on Wednesday, battered by Thailand's decision to float the beleaguered baht, Japanese traders said.
The August, October, November and December rubber futures plunged by their seven yen per kg daily limit. Benchmark December tumbled by seven yen to end at 113.6 yen.
Traders said Thai rubber offer prices were expected to fall sharply due to the change in Thailand's currency system.
"Thai's move dealt another blow to the already bearish market, and prompted investors to actively sell rubber futures," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
